_doc: Data for evidence graphics. A graphic is published only when publish is true, which requires verification 'primary' for every value. Until then it is rendered to docs/graphics-preview/ for reviewers only.

prevalence.title: How common clinical high risk of psychosis is, by sampled population
prevalence.verification_needed: Open Salazar de Pablo et al., Brain Sci 2021;11(11):1544 (doi:10.3390/brainsci11111544) and confirm both estimates, CIs, study and participant counts in the abstract/results, and whether further subgroups (age, setting) are reported.

transition.title: Cumulative risk of developing psychosis over time (pooled meta-analytic estimates)
transition.measure: Cumulative transition risk (%), meta-analytic pooled estimate with 95% confidence interval. Kaplan-Meier estimates from the same paper are deliberately NOT combined here.
transition.verification_needed: Open Salazar de Pablo et al., JAMA Psychiatry 2021;78(9):970-978 (doi:10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2021.0830), Results/Table 2 or Figure, and confirm each pooled estimate and 95% CI at 6, 12, 24, 36 and 48 months (CIs from 18 months onward came from a summary that may quote another article). Confirm these are meta-analytic pooled estimates, not Kaplan-Meier.
